from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rare = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    # The repeated single-cell markers are the unique color occurring many times;
    # the source figure is the compact cluster of the remaining colored cells.
    freq = Counter(v for _,_,v in rare)
    marker_color = max(freq, key=lambda v: freq[v])
    figure = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker_color]
    if not figure:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    minr = min(r for r,c,v in figure)
    minc = min(c for r,c,v in figure)
    pattern = [(r-minr,c-minc,v) for r,c,v in figure]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for cc in range(w):
            if grid[r][cc] == marker_color:
                # Each marker is the pattern cell one row below its top-left.
                top, left = r-1, cc
                for dr,dc,v in pattern:
                    rr, col = top+dr, left+dc
                    if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= col < w:
                        out[rr][col] = v
    return out
